response.sql: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_price FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(average_price) AS baseline_price FROM media_averages), ratios AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.average_price, m.average_price / NULLIF(b.baseline_price, 0) AS ratio FROM media_averages AS m CROSS JOIN baseline AS b) SELECT MediaTypeId, average_price, ratio FROM ratios ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC, MediaTypeId LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A zero baseline yields a NULL ratio because division by zero is undefined.
